question: Among the patients who were diagnosed with SLE, who is the oldest with normal hemoglobin level. Provide the ID and sex.
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "patients_core" AS SELECT "id" AS "id", "sex" AS "sex", "diagnosis" AS "diagnosis", "combined_dates" AS "combined_dates" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "labs" AS SELECT "id" AS "id", "date" AS "date", "hgb" AS "hgb" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "conductor_s_execution" AS
WITH p AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        sex,
        diagnosis,
        CASE
            WHEN combined_dates IS NULL OR combined_dates = '' THEN NULL
            ELSE TRY_CAST(split_part(combined_dates, '|', 1) AS DATE)
        END AS birth_date
    FROM patients_core
    WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%'
),
l AS (
    SELECT id, date, hgb
    FROM labs
    WHERE hgb IS NOT NULL
),
pn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.sex, p.birth_date
    FROM p
    JOIN l ON l.id = p.id
    WHERE (
        UPPER(p.sex) = 'M' AND l.hgb BETWEEN 13.5 AND 17.5
    ) OR (
        UPPER(p.sex) = 'F' AND l.hgb BETWEEN 12.0 AND 15.5
    )
),
oldest AS (
    SELECT MIN(birth_date) AS min_birth_date
    FROM pn
    WHERE birth_date IS NOT NULL
),
winners AS (
    SELECT pn.id, pn.sex, pn.birth_date
    FROM pn
    JOIN oldest o ON pn.birth_date = o.min_birth_date
)
SELECT id, sex
FROM winners;
